propositions: scc_loc.analyze invokes scc via subprocess.run with --format json and parses per-file LOC from a two-level JSON structure (language groups containing file entries with Code and Location fields)
analyzer returns AnalyzerResult with loc payload keyed by repo-relative POSIX-normalized file paths and max_loc as the maximum per-file code count
analyzer fails closed (returns Unavailable with reason and accruing_since constant) when scc binary is missing, exits non-zero, produces empty stdout, or returns unparseable JSON
successful scan with empty file list (e.g. all-ignored tree) returns AnalyzerResult with empty files dict and max_loc zero, not Unavailable
scc_loc.py is self-contained in analyzers/ package, does not import from rebar.grounding, and uses injectable run parameter for testability
